test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: On 30 July 2021, Union Minister Jitendra Singh released __________ guidelines for Promotion of Research and Innovation through Data Exchange.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Biotech-PRIDE**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **On July 30, 2021, Dr Jitendra Singh**, Union Minister of State for Science and Technology, published **"Biotech-PRIDE (Promotion of Research and Innovation via Data Exchange) Guidelines."**
 
• They were created by the Ministry of Science and Technology's Department of Biotechnology (DBT).
 
• The Indian Biological Data Centre, or IBDC, website was also launched by the Minister.
 
• **The Indian Biological Data Centre (IBDC),** a Regional Centre for Biotechnology financed by the Department of Biotechnology, will apply the Guidelines.
 
• This IBDC, which will be dubbed Bio-Grid, will be connected to other existing databases and data centres. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Dr. Jitendra Singh** is a politician and doctor from India who was born on November 6, 1956.
 
• He is the **Minister of State (Independent Charge) for the Department of Atomic Energy, the Department of Space, and the Ministry of Science and Technology.**
 
• He is also the Minister of State (Independent Charge) for the Prime Minister's Office, Personnel, Public Grievances, and Pensions, and the Ministry of Earth Science.
